editor.title: Query (ctrl+e execute · ctrl+p history · ctrl+n complete)
editor.banner: SET search_path TO %s;  -- applied automatically (selected schema)
results.title: Results
results.help.title: Results — Help
results.help.nav.line: gg / G                 first / last line (42G, 5gg: line n)
results.help.nav.halfpage: ctrl+d/u · ctrl+f/b    half page / page down / up
results.help.nav.screen: K / M / J              top / middle / bottom of screen
results.help.nav.tabs: H / L                  previous / next result tab (one per ; statement)
results.help.copy.cellcol: yC  cell with column name (col: value)
results.help.copy.insert: yi  current row as a SQL INSERT · yI  all rows
results.help.search.start: /                      search in results (↵ confirm, esc cancel)
results.help.edit.start: i / ↵                  edit the cell · c  change it (empty value)
results.help.edit.keys: ↵ apply · esc cancel · ctrl+u/w/k delete · ←/→ home/end
results.help.edit.null: the value NULL stores SQL NULL
results.help.edit.require: needs a table column and its primary key in the result
results.help.row: Add / duplicate a row (INSERT into the table of the current column)
results.help.row.start: o  new row · p  duplicate the current row (draft, nothing is written)
results.help.row.edit: i / c  fill a cell · x  reset it to its default value
results.help.row.commit: ctrl+s  insert the row · esc  discard the draft
results.help.row.pk: the primary key of a copy is left to its default (sequence, …)
results.help.misc.esc: esc  return to window mode    q  quit (Q: without confirmation)
window.help.title: Windows — Help
window.help.nav.move: hjkl / arrows / 1 2 3  select a window (g/G: first/last)
window.help.nav.focus: ↵ / i / space          focus the selected window (esc: back)
window.help.nav.cycle: tab / ctrl+j / ctrl+k  next / previous window
status.error.keychain: connection saved, but the password could not be stored in the keychain: %s
status.error.envvar: no password in the keychain and environment variable « %s » is empty or undefined — edit the connection (e) to type the password
statusbar.hints.default: esc windows · ctrl+t actions · ctrl+c quit
statusbar.hints.window: hjkl navigate · ↵ focus · ? help · ctrl+t actions · q quit
statusbar.hints.results: ? help · H/L tabs · / search · i edit · y y/Y/c/C/o/O/a/i/I copy ·
statusbar.hints.celledit: ↵ apply · esc cancel · NULL for null
statusbar.hints.draft: draft · i edit · x default · ctrl+s insert · esc discard
form.field.name: Name
form.placeholder.name: prod
form.desc.name: Name displayed in the connections list
form.desc.host: PostgreSQL server host (docker container: check mapped port)
form.desc.port: TCP port (docker: the *external* port, e.g., 5434 for 5434->5432)
form.desc.password:
The actual password — masked, stored in the OS keychain
   (macOS Keychain / Secret Service), never in config.json · empty = no password
form.hint.normal: j/k navigate · i edit · ctrl+s save · esc close
form.hint.insert: esc normal mode · ↵/tab next field · ctrl+s save
status.row.draft: New row in %s (draft) — ctrl+s to insert it, esc to discard
status.row.draftexists: a row is already being drafted — ctrl+s to insert it, esc to discard it
status.error.row.othercol: this column does not belong to the table of the new row (or is generated)
status.error.cell.computed: Not editable: computed column (not a table column)
status.error.cell.nopk: Not editable: the table has no primary key
status.error.cell.pkmissing: Not editable: select the primary key column(s) too
status.error.cell.otherdb: Not editable: results from another connection/database
help.title: pgak — TUI for navigating PostgreSQL (multi-environment)
help.default:
By default, pgak reopens in the state of the last session: same connection,
same database, same schema, and the editor query is preserved.
help.option.connection: --connexion <name>  connect at launch to the saved connection <name>
help.inapp.nav: hjkl / 1 2 3        navigate between windows · ↵ to focus
help.inapp.esc: esc                 return to window mode (in insert: return to normal mode)
help.inapp.actions: ctrl+t              quick actions (tables, columns, sizes, activity…)
help.inapp.config: ctrl+o              open the config file in $EDITOR
help.passwords:
Passwords: stored in the OS keychain (macOS Keychain / Secret Service),
never in config.json. Type them in the connection form.
confirm.quit.title: Quit pgak?
cli.error.no_connections: no saved connections — run pgak to create one
